upgrade.lead: You can translate your menu into multiple languages so customers can view the menu in their language.
upgrade.body: Built for multilingual menus. Available on Pro and Premium plans (per-language editor, limits based on your subscription, and auto-translate).
upgrade.cardTranslationsDesc: Manage languages per menu, flags on the menu, and edit text for each language.
upgrade.cardAutoDesc: Generate automatic drafts to save time; review and publish when ready.
upgrade.promoTitle: Upgrade to Pro or Premium and try translations plus many more features
upgrade.promoBody: Higher plans unlock multilingual menus, more capacity, and extra tools—compare options and pick what fits your business.

page.publicToggleHint: Use the Public menu switch on each language to show or hide it on the QR menu (it remains available in the editor even when hidden).
page.needBusiness: To create a menu translation you first need at least one business and one menu.
page.selectBusinessHint: Select a business to see its menus.
page.noMenus: There are no menus for this business.

menuCard.autoBadgeTitle: Auto-translate already run for this language
menuCard.publicToggleTitle: When off, the language does not appear on the public menu (it does in the editor)
menuCard.useAsDefaultTitle: This language’s content will become the menu’s primary content

autoTranslate.title: AI auto-translate
autoTranslate.helpShort: Generate a draft from the base language. You can edit it afterwards under “Translate”.
autoTranslate.help: Translates all text from {{source}} into the selected language. Monthly usage depends on your plan. You can edit afterwards under “Translate”.
autoTranslate.force: Force re-translate (uses one credit even if already translated)
autoTranslate.needLocale: Add at least one language other than {{source}}.
autoTranslate.confirmMessage: The menu will be translated from {{source}} to {{locale}}.{{forceNote}}{{extra}} Continue?
autoTranslate.forceNote: Force mode: uses one credit even if the menu already has a previous auto-translation.
autoTranslate.success: Translation ready. Review and edit if needed.
autoTranslate.restaurantHelp: Generate an AI draft of the selected language on every menu of this business.
autoTranslate.restaurantNeedLocales: Add at least one extra language on a menu to use this option.
autoTranslate.restaurantConfirmMessage: All menus of this business that have {{locale}} will be auto-translated from {{source}}.{{forceNote}}{{extra}} Continue?
autoTranslate.restaurantForceNote: Force mode: also re-translates menus that already have an auto-translation.
autoTranslate.restaurantSuccess: Done: {{menus}} menu(s) translated. Review and edit if needed.

addLocale.title: Add language
addLocale.intro: Text from the base language will be copied as a starting point. You can refine it later in the editor.
addLocale.introRestaurant: This language will be added to every menu of the business that does not have it yet. Base-language text is copied as a starting point.
addLocale.restaurantNoneAdded: {{locale}} is already on every menu (or is the base language).
addLocale.searchPlaceholder: Type to search (e.g. English, Catalan, français)…
addLocale.noMatches: No matches. Open “Advanced options” for a custom code.
addLocale.customCodeHelp: Only if the language is not in the list. Format language-region (e.g. en-US).
addLocale.panelLabelHelp: By default we use the language’s own name (English, Español, Français…). You can change it.
addLocale.flagHelp: 2 letters = country flag. More characters = text badge. Leave blank to infer automatically.
addLocale.showPublic: Show on the public menu (QR menu)
addLocale.needLocale: Choose a language from the list or enter a code under advanced options.
addLocale.invalidLocale: Invalid code. Use at least language + region (e.g. en-US, es-MX).
addLocale.alreadyBase: {{locale}} is already the menu’s base language.
addLocale.invalidFlag: Use 2–10 letters or numbers (e.g. ES, US, CAT).
addLocale.success: Language added. You can open the editor to refine the translations.

settings.title: Edit display names
settings.menuNameHelp: This is how the menu appears in the admin panel.
settings.labelsHelp: This is the name shown in the public menu language switcher (e.g. English, Español). You can also adjust the flag and whether it appears on the QR menu.
settings.label: Display name
settings.editNamesHelp: This is the name shown in the panel and in the public menu language switcher (e.g. English, Español).
settings.renameHelp: If you picked the wrong language when creating it, you can fix the code (e.g. from it-IT to en-US). Does not change the menu’s default language.
settings.invalidFlagForLocale: Invalid code for {{locale}}: 2–10 alphanumeric characters (e.g. ES, CAT).
settings.invalidRenameCode: The new code must be valid (e.g. en-US, es-MX, zh-CN).
